rules.scoring: Gains are rest-of-season points (rules.unit), worked in integers: h(x) = round(100*x) of a ros_pg or lineup.ros_floor value as the file carries it (2 decimals), t(x) = round(10*x) of a games value (1 decimal), W = the league's weeks_left. Candidates: every player of the roster, ir true or false, ordered by h(ros_pg) descending, then t(games) descending, then name ascending; each starts with left = t(games). Slot kinds, in order: each position P of lineup.slots (its n, pos list [P]), then each entry of lineup.flex in order (its n and pos list). For each kind: need = n*10*W and bar = the largest h(lineup.ros_floor[p]) over its pos list. Walk the candidates in order; for each whose pos is in the pos list, with left > 0 and h(ros_pg) > bar: take = min(left, need), add h(ros_pg)*take to the total, subtract take from his left and from need; stop when need is 0. Then add bar*need. ros(roster) is that total, in thousandths of a point: a starter's missed games and byes go to the next candidates who can fill the slot, then to the wire. gain = r(ros(R3) - ros(R1)), where R1 is the owner's values list and R3 is R1 minus send, plus get (get players taken from the partner's values list, matched by name, with their own fields), minus drop. Players in ir_moves stay in R3: they return later, and their games already leave out what they miss. r(d) = ((abs(d) + 50) // 100) / 10 with d's sign: points to one decimal, rounded half away from zero. their.gain = r(ros(H3) - ros(H1)) for the partner: H1 his values list, H3 = H1 minus get, plus send (from the owner's list), minus their.drop. An offer is written only when ros(R3) - ros(R1) >= rules.min_gain*1000 and ros(H3) - ros(H1) >= 0 (rules.min_gain is rules.min_gain_week x weeks_left, one decimal, unless a run sets it). starters(roster), which rules.drop reads: the roster's players with ir false in the candidate order; for each position P of lineup.slots the first n unused of position P, then for each entry of lineup.flex in order the first n unused whose pos is in its list.
rules.drop: R2 = the owner's values list minus send plus get (get players from the partner's values list, matched by name, each with its own ir, ir_ok, keep and protect). irs = the players of R2 with ir true. count = the players of R2 with ir false, plus other[owner]. over = count - lineup.cap. When over <= 0, ir_moves and drop are []. Otherwise: (1) IR first. free = max(lineup.ir - irs, 0). Candidates are the players of R2 with ir false and ir_ok true, get players included, ordered by keep descending, then seen descending (as published, 1 decimal), then name ascending. ir_moves = the first min(free, over) candidates, in that order; from here a moved player counts as ir true: he no longer counts toward the cap. over = over - len(ir_moves). (2) Drops. When over > 0: L = the players of R2 with ir false that are not in ir_moves. stay = starters(L) (rules.scoring) plus the get players. pool = the players of L not in stay and with protect false, ordered by keep ascending, then seen ascending (1 decimal), then name ascending. drop = the first `over` of the pool, in that order. When the pool holds fewer than `over` players the offer is not written. keep is the player's rest-of-season points (values.keep = ros_pg x games). Players with protect true are never released (protect is in values: an early draft pick, a player whose keep would start for at least half the other teams at his position, or a player with priced false). K and D/ST (other) are never released or moved. drop and ir_moves are the owner's room; their is the same rule applied to the partner (rules.perceived).
rules.partner: An offer is written only when the partner's rest-of-season gain (their.gain, rules.scoring: his roster after the trade, minus get, plus send, minus his own drop) is at least 0, so he does not lose points by our count, AND his perceived gain (rules.perceived) is above rules.min_perc, so he would see it as a gain. Untested heuristic, not backtested: no trade history to test it on.
rules.select: Each owner's list is one ranked list of offers with every partner. It holds, deduplicated by partner, send names and get names: (1) for each position P of QB, RB, WR and TE, the best rules.per_pos (5) offers whose get holds a player at P, at most rules.per_partner_pos (2) of them with one partner; (2) for each partner, the best rules.top (3) offers with that partner. Best = gain descending, then fewer players (send plus get), then partner name ascending; the list is in that order. With one partner, each set of players asked for appears in at most one offer. An owner with no offer is left out. No offer sends or asks for a player with priced false.
rules.floor: lineup.ros_floor[pos] is the best ros_pg among the league's free-agent file rows that are healthy, on no roster in that league's roster file and not Out or IR, waiver players included (a claim clears in a day or two; a free agent with no rest-of-season row counts 0); 0 when none is left. lineup.floor[pos] is the best proj among the same free agents minus those on waivers (ESPN's waiver flag, the Yahoo leagues' status=W list): next week's wire, for the page's weekly chips, not the gain.
rules.perceived: Untested heuristic (2026-10-05), not backtested: what the partner thinks a player is worth. perceived = seen + 0.5 x streak + leash, 0 for a player whose proj is 0 (out next week). streak = last2 - seen (0 with fewer than 2 games), last2 = his average over the last 2 games he played in the league's scoring. leash = 0.5 x max(0, round median - seen) for draft rounds 1-3 only; round median = the median seen of that league's rostered players drafted in that round who have played. The round is the league's draft file's; a player that league never drafted has none, and ESPN's round for the same player stands in only for a league with no draft file at all. The partner's perceived gain = his weekly lineup by perceived after the trade minus before (players with ir false, fixed slots then flex, highest perceived first), every slot floored at the best available free agent by perceived, his roster after the trade minus their.ir_moves and their.drop. their = rules.drop applied to the partner: R2 = the partner's values list minus get plus send (send players from the owner's values list, each with its own fields), other[partner], and his incoming players (send) never dropped; an offer whose partner has no legal drop is not written. How the perceived gain decides whether an offer is written: rules.partner. Not in values: a reader cannot re-derive perceived.
rules.namesake: No offer's get holds a player the partner's team name is built on: a player whose first or last name (letters and apostrophes, 4+ characters, not Jr or Sr) appears inside the partner's team name, case-blind.
rules.chips: chips per player: "Hot" when streak >= 4.0, "Cold" when streak <= -4.0 (streak = last2 - seen, unrounded), "Early pick" for a draft round 1-3 (the league's draft file; ESPN's round for the same player only in a league with no draft file). last2 is null with fewer than 2 games.
